item.title: The Bird-in-Hand Hot Air Balloon Festival — Fri Sep 25, 3:00 PM — Bird -In -Hand PA
item.description:
See the skies come alive in Bird-In-Hand, PA! 🎈 Get ready for an unforgettable weekend in the heart of Amish Country filled with colorful Hot Air Balloons, great food, music and family fun.
Climb aboard and experience the thrill of rising above the festival grounds, weather permitting & while availability lasts. Ride tickets are sold onsite only. 🚜 Free Hayrides: Climb aboard and enjoy a relaxing hayride through the beautiful Bird-in-Hand countryside — included FREE with admission🎶Music & Entertainment: Our DJ keeps the festival going with great music throughout the evening🛍️ Browse Craft & Retail Vendors for handmade goods, unique finds and festival favorites. 🍔 Come hungry! Enjoy everything from savory favorites to sweet treats from our lineup of food vendors. 👧👦 Kids Zone: Games, rides and plenty of fun for the little ones! Kids Zone is vendor operated. Individual activities generally range from $5–$20. 🔥 THEN AT ~8:30 PM — LOOK UP! ✨🎈 HOT AIR BALLOON GLOW & LASER SHOW!
🧺

item.title: Bridges & Brunch with Strasburg Scooter Tours — Sat Sep 26 — Strasburg Scooter Tours
item.description:
Experience a relaxing morning ride through the back roads of Amish Country in Lancaster County, PA. Along the way to a 19th century covered bridge, enjoy the scenery of rolling hills, breathtaking views, and our Amish neighbors going about their daily routines. Itinerary Duration: 1.5-2 hours Some of our past tours have included:
A guided tour of one of Lancaster County’s most beautiful covered bridges An opportunity for a close up of daily life in Amish Country $10 dining voucher to one of two of Strasburg’s favorites brunch spots, Casey Jones’ Restaurant and Speckled Hen*
And each trip is unique, so you never know what we might have in store for you! *Unfortunately, we regret to inform you that some of the food offerings on the tour may not be considered ‘Kosher.’ We apologize for any inconvenience.
Source: Discover Lancaster

item.description:
Enjoy a 5-star Lancaster County ice cream tour experience with Strasburg Scooter Tours. You’ll see rolling farmlands, pass by horse and buggies, and enjoy some of the best Ice Cream in Lancaster County! It’s a stark contrast to the usual fast-paced and congested areas of larger cities. item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Sat Sep 26, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.

item.title: Make Your Own Salt Dough Handprint Pumpkin Keepsake — Fri Oct 9, 10:30 AM — Eastern Lancaster County
item.description:
Arts & Crafts, Babies, Toddlers, Children
Little hands, big memories! 🎃✨Celebrate the autumn season by creating a timeless memory with your little ones! Join us for our Make Your Own Salt Dough Handprint Pumpkin Keepsake workshop. This hands-on, family-friendly crafting event is perfect for infants, toddlers, preschoolers, and young children.You and your child will roll out classic homemade salt dough. Your child will leave their unique impression in the dough, which you will then shape into an adorable seasonal pumpkin. We’ll provide all the essential crafting ingredients, so you can customize your keepsake with your child’s name and the year. Registration is required to make sure we supply enough dough!Note for parents: Salt dough requires time to fully dry or bake. Participants will take their molded creations home with clear instructions on how to easily bake or air-dry and seal their pumpkins to ensure they last for years to come!
Source: Lancaster Libraries

Why Inclusion is Good Business with Jane HoranMost leaders believe their team is inclusive, but their team often see it differently. Drawing on case studies and coaching stories from Coaching Inclusion, this talk makes the business case for inclusion in plain terms: better decisions, stronger retention, and helping leaders access the full range of expertise in the room.
